title.en: EVE Academy – How to Find a Corp

blocks.en: Finding friends to fly with opens up a whole new realm of experiences
blocks.zh: 找到一起飞行的伙伴，会为你的 EVE 之旅

blocks.en: and adventures in your EVE journey.
blocks.zh: 开启全新的体验和冒险。

blocks.en: Players can form their own corporations and work together towards shared goals.
blocks.zh: 玩家可以创建自己的军团，为共同的目标协作。

blocks.en: These corporations can even band together into Alliances,
blocks.zh: 这些军团还能组成联盟，

blocks.en: some of which are massive with tens of thousands of members.
blocks.zh: 其中一些规模庞大，成员多达数万人。

blocks.en: Finding a corporation that's right for you can greatly enhance your experience
blocks.zh: 找到适合你的军团能大大提升游戏体验，

blocks.en: and give you the support you need to survive and thrive amidst the dangers of New Eden.
blocks.zh: 并为你提供在新伊甸的重重危险中生存和发展所需的支持。

blocks.en: Most corporations in EVE specialize in certain styles of gameplay,
blocks.zh: EVE 中大多数军团专注于某些特定的玩法，

blocks.en: often shaped by the space in which they live.
blocks.zh: 这往往取决于他们所在的星域类型。

blocks.en: As you look for a group that suits your interests,
blocks.zh: 在寻找符合你兴趣的团体时，

blocks.en: consider the type of space that most interests you
blocks.zh: 想想你最感兴趣的是哪种空间，

blocks.en: and look for corporations that call those places home.
blocks.zh: 然后寻找以那里为家的军团。

blocks.en: Highsec corporations tend to focus on PvE gameplay styles
blocks.zh: 高安军团通常专注于 PvE 玩法，

blocks.en: such as mission running, mining and industry.
blocks.zh: 比如刷任务、采矿和工业。

blocks.en: However, this doesn't mean that PvP doesn't occur for those in highsec corporations.
blocks.zh: 不过，这并不意味着高安军团的成员就不会遇到 PvP。

blocks.en: Groups that build structures become vulnerable to declarations of war
blocks.zh: 建造建筑的团体会受到其他玩家团体的

blocks.en: from other player groups, and may find themselves fighting to protect their assets
blocks.zh: 宣战威胁，可能不得不为保护资产而战，

blocks.en: or even going on the offensive to attack their rivals.
blocks.zh: 甚至主动出击，攻击竞争对手。

blocks.en: Some highsec corporations even make criminal 'ganking' of others a way of life,
blocks.zh: 有些高安军团甚至以犯罪性质的「自杀式攻击（Gank）」为生，

blocks.en: frequently losing their ships to CONCORD,
blocks.zh: 他们经常被统合部击毁舰船，

blocks.en: but often taking their targets down with them.
blocks.zh: 但往往也会把目标一起带走。

blocks.en: Corporations which call low-security space home
blocks.zh: 以低安为家的军团

blocks.en: often find themselves involved in small scale pvp engagements,
blocks.zh: 经常卷入小规模 PvP 交战，

blocks.en: either through faction warfare or general piracy.
blocks.zh: 不论是通过势力战争还是一般的海盗行为。

blocks.en: Those corporations which are enlisted in a faction's militia
blocks.zh: 加入某个势力民兵的军团

blocks.en: will often work together to conquer space for their faction,
blocks.zh: 通常会协同作战，为自己的势力夺取星域，

blocks.en: while others may focus on a criminal life,
blocks.zh: 另一些军团则可能专注于犯罪生涯，

blocks.en: working to free innocent passerbys from their ships
blocks.zh: 致力于把无辜路人「解放」出他们的舰船，

blocks.en: and take whatever valuable loot they had on board.
blocks.zh: 并拿走船上所有值钱的战利品。

blocks.en: As with any space, there may also be corporations which aren't as PvP focused,
blocks.zh: 和其他任何空间一样，也有一些军团不那么专注 PvP，

blocks.en: instead preferring to avoid conflicts when they can
blocks.zh: 而是尽量避免冲突，

blocks.en: and profit from the space around them.
blocks.zh: 从周围的空间中获利。

blocks.en: However, sometimes a fight simply cannot be avoided.
blocks.zh: 然而，有时战斗根本无法避免。

blocks.en: Null security space is divided into two types, NPC and Sovereign space.
blocks.zh: 00 区分为两种：NPC 空间和主权空间。

blocks.en: NPC space is owned by NPC corporations and cannot be claimed by players.
blocks.zh: NPC 空间归 NPC 军团所有，玩家无法占领。

blocks.en: Corporations here tend to be smaller
blocks.zh: 这里的军团规模往往较小，

blocks.en: and often similar in lifestyle to low security pirate groups.
blocks.zh: 生活方式常常与低安的海盗团体类似。

blocks.en: Sovereign nullsec on the other hand is home to massive player empires,
blocks.zh: 而主权 00 区则是庞大玩家帝国的家园，

blocks.en: which frequently come into conflict as they vie for dominance and control of star systems.
blocks.zh: 它们为争夺星系的主导权和控制权频繁爆发冲突。

blocks.en: Corporations and their alliances, which make their home in sov null
blocks.zh: 以主权 00 区为家的军团及其联盟

blocks.en: will often find themselves defending or attacking space in large fleets.
blocks.zh: 常常要以大规模舰队防守或进攻星域。

blocks.en: If you're interested in participating in massive fleet fights,
blocks.zh: 如果你想参与大规模舰队战，

blocks.en: look for a well-established nullsec group to join.
blocks.zh: 就去找一个成熟的 00 区团体加入吧。

blocks.en: Many of these groups are happy to take on newer players.
blocks.zh: 其中很多团体都乐意接纳新玩家。

blocks.en: Even the smallest frigate can turn the tide of a major battle.
blocks.zh: 哪怕是最小的护卫舰，也能扭转一场大战的局势。

blocks.en: And lastly, some groups choose to make their homes in wormhole space.
blocks.zh: 最后，有些团体选择以虫洞空间为家。

blocks.en: Wormholes offer unique challenges as the routes to and from wormhole systems
blocks.zh: 虫洞带来独特的挑战：进出虫洞星系的路线

blocks.en: are regularly shifting and need to be scanned down,
blocks.zh: 会定期变化，需要扫描才能找到，

blocks.en: and local chat does not show potentially hostile players
blocks.zh: 而且本地频道不会显示

blocks.en: who may be lurking nearby.
blocks.zh: 可能潜伏在附近的敌对玩家。

blocks.en: Because of this, ambush attacks from cloaked ships are common,
blocks.zh: 因此，隐形舰船的伏击很常见，

blocks.en: and pilots need to always be on guard.
blocks.zh: 飞行员必须时刻保持警惕。

blocks.en: Structures anchored in wormhole space also drop all of their contents upon destruction,
blocks.zh: 虫洞空间中锚定的建筑被摧毁时会掉落全部内容物，

blocks.en: so evictions are common as attackers invade wormholes
blocks.zh: 所以驱逐战很常见，进攻方会入侵虫洞，

blocks.en: seeking to steal the defender's belongings.
blocks.zh: 企图掠夺防守方的财产。

blocks.en: The brutality of wormhole life can make it tough to get started as a new player.
blocks.zh: 虫洞生活的残酷让新玩家很难起步。

blocks.en: But there are some corps which would be happy to show you the ropes, if you're brave enough.
blocks.zh: 但如果你够勇敢，也有一些军团乐意带你入门。

blocks.en: Once you have an idea of the type of group you're interested in joining,
blocks.zh: 等你大致想好要加入哪种类型的团体，

blocks.en: it's time to start the hunt.
blocks.zh: 就可以开始寻找了。

blocks.en: Corporations try to advertise themselves through many channels in and out of game,
blocks.zh: 军团会通过游戏内外的许多渠道宣传自己，

blocks.en: so there is not necessarily a 'best' way to go about finding one.
blocks.zh: 所以寻找军团并没有所谓的「最佳」方式。

blocks.en: It's recommended you search around multiple channels and try to find the best corporation for you.
blocks.zh: 建议多看几个渠道，找到最适合你的军团。

blocks.en: In game, corporations can list recruitment advertisements which you can search through.
blocks.zh: 在游戏中，军团可以发布招募广告供你搜索。

blocks.en: To view recruiting corporations in-game,
blocks.zh: 要在游戏内查看正在招人的军团，

blocks.en: click the Neocom menu in the top left-hand corner of the screen,
blocks.zh: 点击屏幕左上角的 Neocom 菜单，

blocks.en: go to Social and then click on Corporation.
blocks.zh: 进入「社交（Social）」，再点击「军团（Corporation）」。

blocks.en: In the Corporation window, you then want to click on the Recruitment tab,
blocks.zh: 在军团窗口中，点击「招募（Recruitment）」标签页，

blocks.en: and then on Search.
blocks.zh: 然后点击「搜索（Search）」。

blocks.en: Here you can find a list of recruiting corporations,
blocks.zh: 这里会列出正在招募的军团，

blocks.en: carefully tune the search results to fit what you're looking for.
blocks.zh: 仔细调整搜索条件，找到你想要的。

blocks.en: You can choose types of gameplay that interest you,
blocks.zh: 你可以选择感兴趣的玩法类型、

blocks.en: the type of space you'd be interested in living in,
blocks.zh: 想要居住的空间类型、

blocks.en: your language, play times and even how large you would like the corporation to be.
blocks.zh: 你的语言、游戏时间，甚至期望的军团规模。

blocks.en: You can then click through the various advertisements on the right-hand side of the window
blocks.zh: 然后可以在窗口右侧逐个点开各条广告，

blocks.en: to reveal a bit more about them.
blocks.zh: 了解更多信息。

blocks.en: If you want to chat a bit with a group before joining,
blocks.zh: 如果你想在加入前先和某个团体聊聊，

blocks.en: or have any questions about a corporation,
blocks.zh: 或者对某个军团有任何疑问，

blocks.en: many groups have public channels where you can chat with recruiters.
blocks.zh: 很多团体都有公共频道，可以在那里和招募人员交流。

blocks.en: Just Show info on a corporation and check their bio for a link.
blocks.zh: 只需对军团点击「显示信息（Show Info）」，在简介中找到频道链接。

blocks.en: Corporations also advertise out of game through venues
blocks.zh: 军团也会在游戏外宣传，比如

blocks.en: such as the official EVE forums or the EVE Jobs subreddit.
blocks.zh: 官方 EVE 论坛或 Reddit 上的 EVE Jobs 版块。

blocks.en: Feel free to check these resources out.
blocks.zh: 不妨去看看这些资源。

blocks.en: You can even just chat with other pilots you've interacted with in-game and ask for suggestions!
blocks.zh: 你甚至可以直接问问游戏里打过交道的其他飞行员，听听他们的建议！

blocks.en: Once you've found a corporation you want to apply to,
blocks.zh: 找到想申请的军团后，

blocks.en: be sure to double-check their advertisement
blocks.zh: 一定要再仔细看看他们的广告，

blocks.en: for details on their application process.
blocks.zh: 了解申请流程的细节。

blocks.en: It's not unusual for EVE corporations to request applications to be submitted
blocks.zh: EVE 军团要求通过第三方工具在游戏外提交申请

blocks.en: out of game via third party tools, particularly for larger corporations,
blocks.zh: 并不罕见，大型军团尤其如此，

blocks.en: as this allows them to more easily authenticate you
blocks.zh: 因为这样能更方便地验证你的身份，

blocks.en: into the various tools and IT services the group uses.
blocks.zh: 让你接入团体使用的各种工具和 IT 服务。

blocks.en: Some of the IT services large alliances employ rival those of real world corporations!
blocks.zh: 一些大联盟使用的 IT 服务，甚至能和现实中的企业媲美！

blocks.en: In this example, you can see us logging into EVE-HR,
blocks.zh: 在这个例子中，我们正在登录 EVE-HR，

blocks.en: a third party application management system used by many EVE corporations.
blocks.zh: 这是许多 EVE 军团使用的第三方申请管理系统。

blocks.en: Once you've been approved and invited to a corporation, congratulations!
blocks.zh: 一旦你通过审核并收到军团邀请，恭喜你！

blocks.en: You can accept the invite by opening the corporation window in game,
blocks.zh: 在游戏中打开军团窗口即可接受邀请：

blocks.en: clicking your Recruitment tab and then clicking the My applications tab.
blocks.zh: 点击「招募」标签页，再点击「我的申请（My Applications）」标签页。

blocks.en: Once you join the corporation, be sure to review all of the introductory material
blocks.zh: 加入军团后，一定要阅读游戏内欢迎邮件中

blocks.en: they provide in the welcome mail you receive in game,
blocks.zh: 提供的所有入门资料，

blocks.en: set up any IT services they make use of for communication,
blocks.zh: 配置好他们用于沟通的各种 IT 服务，

blocks.en: and start getting to know your new corp mates!
blocks.zh: 然后开始认识你的新军团伙伴吧！
